title: Egg-shaped object descends in the Kilo area
place_text: Kilo area near Kilo 10, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I only saw one other thing in the kilo area and it was an object that looked like an egg that went straight to the ground

plain: In 1978 an object shaped like an egg went straight down to the ground in the "Kilo" area near the launch site called Kilo 10, part of the nuclear missile field run from Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who served there. Woods says he saw it himself and mentions a fellow airman named Mark Wade, telling it on an episode where veterans who say they were taken by aliens meet again 50 years later.
